objective.text: Redesign the carton packaging for Dancing Fish Granola Berry Crunch in the United States market, ensuring every printed value matches a confirmed fact.

nutrition.text: State 8 Servings per container on the nutrition panel.
List Total Fat at 15 g, Saturated Fat at 5 g, and Trans Fat at 8 g.
Include Cholesterol at 45 mg and Protein at 34 g.
Display Dietary Fiber at 3 g, Total Sugars at 18 g, and Incl. Added Sugars · % Daily Value at 0 %.
Present Vitamin D at 89 mcg, Calcium at 206 mg, Iron at 5 mg, and Potassium at 23 mg.
